title: Operator pre-upgrade annotations skew: rescue patch, runbook, and backport
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Production customer reported a failed private deployment upgrade where the operator refused to reconcile post-helm-upgrade. Root cause: annotations and a deprecated list-type field on the CRD created a semantic version skew between the operator's admission webhook and the control-plane CRD conversions, causing webhook rejects and a cascading operator restart loop. This ticket covers triage, immediate mitigation for the affected customers, a minimal hotfix to auto-normalize legacy annotations during admission, backports to the stable 2.13.x branch, a short runbook for future incidents, and the post-release coordination with Support and SEs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Install v2.12.x operator with older CRD that stores `nodeagent.images` as a single string. 2) Helm upgrade with chart version that introduces CRD validation and converts to `nodeagent.images` array. 3) Attempt to apply existing customer CR that still contains legacy annotation `redwood.io/managed-by: legacy-operator`. 4) Operator webhook rejects due to type mismatch -> operator crashloop when it attempts reconciliation and update.
mitigation_summary:
- Provided immediate workaround to affected customers: add temporary annotation `redwood.io/skip-validation: true` on CRs or apply a lightweight CRD patch to accept both string/array for `nodeagent.images`.
- Support-run script distributed to SEs to add skip annotation across customer namespaces.
- Rolled operator-2.14.1-hotfix which performs admission-time normalization: if `nodeagent.images` is string, convert to single-element array and remove legacy `redwood.io/managed-by` sentinel before persisting.

2025-11-05 - Marco Diaz: Implemented proof-of-concept admission normalizer. Opened GH PR #1123 (operator: admission-normalize-legacy-annotations). Patch accepted after review; added unit tests for both string/array shapes.

2025-11-10 - Product (M. Torres): Sent customer-facing incident summary and permanent upgrade guidance. Scheduled postmortem in Confluence.

2025-11-12 - Marco Diaz: Released operator-2.14.1-hotfix to private channel for immediate adopters and released 2.13.7 backport for customers pinned to 2.13.x. Updated Helm chart notes with explicit pre-upgrade checklist.

2025-11-14 - Aisha Kumar: Postmortem draft complete. Follow-ups: add CRD migration script to CLI, add alert when admission webhook error rate spikes, and add automated preflight helm-check that detects legacy annotation shapes.
